FLASHSCORE PREVIEW

West Ham are the home team and Stoke City the away team for a Championship fixture at London Stadium. The match is round 18, with odds bookmakers offered on this match giving West Ham a 57% win probability against Stoke City’s 21%.

Current Form - West Ham

West Ham are 13th on 24 points after 17 matches, with six wins, six draws and five losses and a 38-25 goals record. Their last league match ended in a 1-0 loss away to Portsmouth, while their form across the previous five matches includes two draws and three losses. The Hammers’ run comprises six matches without a win. They have scored 1.2 goals per match across that window, compared with 2.2 for the season, and conceded 2.0 per match against a season figure of 1.5. Their expected goals average is 2.09, compared with a league average of 1.47, while expected goals conceded stands at 1.2 against 1.47.

Current Form - Stoke City

Stoke City sit second on 35 points after 17 matches, level on points with leaders Middlesbrough and carrying 11 wins, two draws and four losses. Their last league match was a 2-1 home win over Millwall, and the Potters have won all five of their most recent matches. Their run comprises seven matches without a defeat. Over those five matches, they scored 1.8 goals per game and conceded 0.6, compared with season figures of 1.6 and 1.1. Their expected goals average is 1.1 against a league average of 1.47, while expected goals conceded is 1.42 against 1.47.

Head-to-Head Record

West Ham won one, drew three and lost one of their last five meetings with Stoke City. The average was 2.0 goals per match. Their most recent meeting was a 1-1 draw, with West Ham at home; the two teams meet for the first time since April 2018.

West Ham vs Stoke City

Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

Jarrod Bowen, a forward, has seven goals and seven assists for West Ham. Konstantinos Mavropanos, a defender, has six goals in 15 matches, while Max Kilman, also a defender, has two goals in 16 matches. Kyle Walker-Peters has one goal and two assists this season but is unavailable for this match.

Jack McGlynn is Stoke City’s top scorer, with five goals and three assists as a midfielder in 13 matches. George Hirst has four goals and one assist in 16 matches, including three goals across his last two matches and two in his latest match. Ethan Galbraith has three goals and four assists in 15 matches as a midfielder. Lamine Cisse is unavailable because of a muscle injury.

Key Numbers

West Ham

➕ Headed goals: 0.41 per match (best in the league, league average 0.20)

➕ Through passes: 1.8 per match (best in the league, league average 0.8)

➕ Big chances conceded: 1.6 per match (3rd best, league average 2.3)

Stoke City

➖ Expected goals (xG): 1.10 per match (4th worst, league average 1.47)

➖ Touches in opposition box: 17.6 per match (2nd worst, league average 23.8)

Match Notes

Max Kilman received four yellow cards across nine appearances in the last 10 matches. Stoke City’s Luca Bombino received one red card two matches ago. Aaron Cresswell is now at Stoke City after arriving directly from West Ham; he made 312 appearances and scored 10 goals for West Ham across 11 seasons.

Betting Insights

The odds give over 2.5 goals a 56% probability and both teams to score a 55% probability.
